description: Get the status and results of a launch inspection. Waits up to about 25 seconds for a running inspection; if it is still running, call again. When done, returns the launch status (Not launch ready / No blockers found · fixes to schedule / No issues found in these automated checks; never a guarantee of legal compliance), each finding with its severity, where it is, why it matters (the law or standard) and how to fix it, plus a link to the full visual report.
name: get_launch_inspection
title: Get launch inspection results
